content.en: The **Agreement on Agriculture (AoA)** is the cornerstone of WTO rules regarding farm trade. It aims to reform trade in agriculture by reducing trade-distorting support. It is built on three pillars: **Market Access**, **Domestic Support**, and **Export Competition**.
